caseNameFull: United States v. Morrison and Brzonkala v. Morrison

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 527 U. S. 1068.] Motions of Association of the Bar of the City of New York, Equal Rights Advocates et al., Lawyers’ Committee for Civil Rights Under Law et al., and Association of Trial Lawyers of America for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted.
